name: Nsing Technologies Inc.
summary: Nsing Technologies Inc. provides integrated circuit (IC) products and services in China and internationally. The company offers MCU, BMS chips, RF chips, automotive, and power products; micro authentication, computing, and security chips; and Bluetooth wireless RF chips. It also offers lithium-ion battery anode materials, as well as graphitization processing services. The company's products are used in consumer electronics, medical electronics, home appliances, digital power, automotive electronics, internet of things, and industrial electronics applications.
